title: Basis-normalized tensor pullback of a free module sheaf
statement: Let $g:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes and $I$ a set. Write $g^*$ for tensor-formula module pullback with its canonical adjunction [def-pc-module-pullback], and let $\epsilon_g:g^*\mathcal O_Y\to\mathcal O_X$ be the pinned structure-sheaf map [def-sfb-tensor-pullback-structure-sheaf-map]. Define the basis-normalized isomorphism $c_{g,I}:g^*(\mathcal O_Y^{\oplus I})\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal O_X^{\oplus I}$ as the inverse of the coproduct comparison induced by $\epsilon_g^{-1}$, using that $g^*$ is a left adjoint. Thus on the summand indexed by $i\in I$ its forward map is $g^*\mathcal O_Y\xrightarrow{\epsilon_g}\mathcal O_X\xrightarrow{\iota_i}\mathcal O_X^{\oplus I}$: $g^*\iota_i\,;\,c_{g,I}=\epsilon_g\,;\,\iota_i$. This fixes the actual map and its inverse, including when $I$ is empty; no arbitrary isomorphism is chosen.
